title: PlaceSeek: Human-Centered Geospatial Retrieval of Urban Outdoor Places via Semantic Grounding and Affective Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.24133v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: People search for urban outdoor places not only by category or function, but also by what activities a place can support and how it is perceived. Existing geospatial retrieval remains largely POIcentric and metadata-driven, making it difficult to satisfy openended, affective, or activity-oriented needs. We present PlaceSeek, a human-centered outdoor place retrieval framework that maps natural-language queries to geolocated street-view imagery. PlaceSeek introduces an intent-aware retrieval mechanism that decomposes user queries into functional and affective sub-intents. A Semantic Grounding Module verifies whether candidate street-view results contain the physical evidence needed to support the intended activity, while an Affective Alignment Module re-ranks physically valid candidates using a LoRA-adapted vision-language model trained on human urban perception judgments. We evaluate PlaceSeek on 31,956 street-view locations in Milan ac

translated_title: 场所探寻：通过语义锚定与情感对齐实现以人为本的城市室外场所地理空间检索
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.24133v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：人们搜索城市室外场所不仅依据类别或功能，还依据场所能支持的活动及其感知方式。现有的地理空间检索大多以兴趣点为中心且依赖元数据，难以满足开放式、情感化或活动导向的需求。我们提出了PlaceSeek，一个以人为本的室外场所检索框架，它将自然语言查询映射到地理定位的街景图像。PlaceSeek引入了一种意图感知的检索机制，将用户查询分解为功能性和情感性子意图。语义锚定模块验证候选街景结果是否包含支持预期活动所需的物理证据，而情感对齐模块则使用在人类城市感知判断上训练的LoRA适配视觉语言模型，对物理上有效的候选结果进行重新排序。我们在米兰的31,956个街景位置对PlaceSeek进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了PlaceSeek，一种通过将自然语言查询分解为功能和情感子意图，并结合语义验证与情感重排序的街景图像检索框架，以支持以人为本的城市室外场所搜索。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PlaceSeek, a framework that decomposes natural language queries into functional and affective sub-intents, and combines semantic verification with affective re-ranking of street-view imagery to support human-centered urban outdoor place retrieval.
